description: Read-only EU free-movement and EU-family visa guidance with evidence-gated source research and an externally maintained legal-source library bundled in the plugin. Currentness checks use official publishers. No automatic submissions or private-case script ingestion.

interface.longDescription: Read-only EU free-movement and EU-family visa guidance with evidence-gated source research, legal-source review, and controlled synthetic eudirective tools. EU, Swedish member-state, Türkiye applicant-country, and registered national-source questions retain separate source owners and coverage rules. Includes the externally maintained EU and national source library mirrored into the plugin package. The bundled corpus is a versioned snapshot; consult official publishers to confirm live currentness.
interface.shortDescription: EU legal guidance and source research
